healthWatcher.name: Loan Safety Check
healthWatcher.description: Works out the health factor of a lending position from the collateral and debt you supply, and how far collateral can fall before liquidation.

skills.name: Health factor check
skills.description: Computes the health factor and the collateral drop that would trigger liquidation.

inputs.label: Collateral in USD
inputs.description: current value of the collateral in USD

inputs.label: Debt in USD
inputs.description: current value of the debt in USD

inputs.label: Liquidation threshold
inputs.description: fraction above 0 and at most 1, such as 0.8

skills.answer: Health factor {hf.healthFactor} ({hf.state}) for collateral {input.collateral} USD and debt {input.debt} USD. Collateral can fall {hf.collateralDropPercent}% before liquidation, and the position can take {hf.additionalDebtUsd:2} USD more debt.

rangePlanner.name: Pancake Range Planner
rangePlanner.description: Suggests a PancakeSwap v3 liquidity range around the live WBNB/USDT price and shows how a deposit splits between the two tokens.

skills.name: Range plan
skills.description: Reads the pool price and sets a range of the width you choose around it.

inputs.label: Range width in percent
inputs.description: full width of the range around the price, such as 10

inputs.label: Deposit in USDT
inputs.description: amount to deposit, valued in USDT

skills.answer: WBNB is at {pool.price:2} USDT at block {pool.blockNumber}. A {input.widthPercent}% range runs from {range.priceLower:2} to {range.priceUpper:2} USDT, ticks {range.tickLower} to {range.tickUpper}. The deposit splits into {range.baseAmount} WBNB and {range.quoteAmount} USDT.

yieldComparer.name: Yield Side by Side
yieldComparer.description: Compares two yield options after compounding and fees, and says which one nets more on your principal over a year.

skills.name: Compare two yields
skills.description: Works out the net yearly rate of two options and names the better one.

inputs.label: Principal in USD
inputs.description: amount you would deposit, in USD

inputs.label: APY of option A
inputs.description: gross APY of the first option, as a percentage

inputs.label: APY of option B
inputs.description: gross APY of the second option, as a percentage

inputs.label: Fee of option A
inputs.description: yearly fee of the first option in basis points

inputs.label: Fee of option B
inputs.description: yearly fee of the second option in basis points

skills.answer: Option A nets {a.netRatePercent}% a year, {a.projectedEarningsUsd:2} USD on {input.principal} USD. Option B nets {b.netRatePercent}%, {b.projectedEarningsUsd:2} USD. The better one is {pick.higher}, by {pick.difference} percentage points.
